title: Foot strike patterns of runners at the 15-km point during an elite-level half marathon
publisher: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
claims: Researchers filmed 415 runners at the 15 km point of an elite-level half marathon with two high-speed cameras and obtained analysable images for 283 runners.
Rearfoot strike was observed in 74.9% of analysed runners, midfoot strike in 23.7% and forefoot strike in 1.4%.
The study describes foot strike patterns in a competitive race setting rather than in a laboratory.
